info.title: Mishwark Backend API
info.description:
Mishwark car-rental & chauffeur booking backend.

Base URL: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`

Authentication: JWT Bearer token from `POST /auth/otp/verify`. Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Dev OTP bypass code: `0000`.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login, 2FA and OTP. Signup accepts a `role` flag of 'customer' (default) or 'driver'.

tags.name: Vehicles
tags.description: Fleet catalogue. Public - no token required.

tags.name: Waitlist
tags.description: Waitlist queue for fully booked vehicles.

tags.name: Wallet
tags.description: Balance and transactions. Credit/debit require the wallet:manage permission.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Admin-only. Requires the ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN role.

DistanceComparison.description: What the client claimed next to what the server computed. Used for auditing only - the client's figures never affect the price.

withinTolerance.description: True when the claim is within 10% of the server figure.

source.description: haversine means no ORS_API_KEY or the provider was unreachable - the figure is a straight-line estimate.

distanceKm.description: Optional hint. Recomputed server-side and never priced.
